description: List the matches of a tournament by providing the tournament ID. Returns each match with its round, both teams with their players and seeds, scheduled time, court, status, score, winner and duration. To get the tournament ID, use the "search-tournaments" tool.

category.description: Category of the match. Either `men` or `women`.

court.description: Filter matches by court name (partial match).

draw.description: Draw the matches belong to: `main`, `qualy`, `group` or `placement` (team tournaments only), or `all` for every draw in a single list. Defaults to `main`: the other draws are only returned when explicitly requested.

order_by.description: Order of the sorting, either `asc` or `desc`.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Results are paginated: check `meta` (`current_page`, `last_page`, `total`) in the response and request further pages with this parameter until you have all the results you need.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Use a small value when you only need the top results (e.g. 1 for the most recent match), or 50 to minimize pages when you need the complete list.

played_at.description: Filter matches played on this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

round.description: Filter matches by round (1 = Final, 2 = Semifinal, 4 = Quarterfinal, 8 = Round of 16, 16 = Round of 32, 32 = Round of 64, 0 = group stage of team tournaments). Avoid using this parameter if you are also filtering by played_at.

sort_by.description: Sort matches by this field. Use `court_order` to follow the order of play within each court.

tournament_id.description: The ID of the tournament to list matches for

name: list-tournament-matches
